title: 第18章 目标 星海一中第19章 来份最猛的药剂
content_zh:
只是有机会么？
嗯，想想也是，同等成绩下，学校往往会更倾向于天赋资质好的学生，这是正常的招生策略。
毕竟气血、身体强度都可以靠食补和药浴，甚至扎针打药堆起来，只要有钱，下品凡骨也能成为同龄人之中的“天才”。
可越往后修炼，武骨资质差的弊端就显现了，除非武骨觉醒，提升天赋资质，否则有钱作用也不大。
“不过中考的时候会重新测试资质，这点其实我不用担心。”
到时候证明了自己武骨不差，入青江一中并不难。
对此，王生倒是不着急跟老秦解释。
课程继续。
老秦以张志超为例，指点他的战斗技巧与决策经验的不足，更是拓展讲授了异能的多种实战应用法。
至于王生，老秦没教。
不是偏袒什么的，而是老秦发现王生几乎不用指点。
一方面王生的异能和武道契合度很高，作战思路不需要更改，以前学的知识更加有用了。
另一方面，单从王生最近几次实战练习的表现来看，能力的确无可挑剔。
这样的人无需过多雕琢，自己即可修炼成才，但至于能走多远，就看他自身的天赋与机缘了。
随着老秦的深入讲解，课程进展到后半段，实战对练开始了。
同学们各自寻找对手，尽可能地开发异能的实战作用，大家进步都很大。
时间很快来到了中午放学。
办公室内，王生站到了老秦的办公桌旁，等待发落。
“王生，你如今不论是气血值还是战斗能力，都已经令人刮目相看了，说实在的，我认为你考青江一中有机会，并不是说假话，而是真的认为可行。”
老秦一边端着泡着枸杞的保温杯，一边赞许道。

“如果放在之前，你能到达这样优异的成绩，就算是想谈恋爱，我都会睁一只眼闭一只眼，都是这个年纪过来的，谁不清楚呢？”
王生：“......”
王生很想解释他没有早恋，但还是默默站在一旁听着教诲。
“可现在不同了，跟中考在即没关系，而是目标对象的问题......我就跟你直说吧，我和刘盈婉的父亲聊过了，最终他决定让刘盈婉去读星海一中。”
星海一中？
闻声，王生神情微变，但也不意外。
以刘盈婉的异能潜力来看，进入星海一中并不是难事。
即便是在那所省会城市最顶尖的高中，刘盈婉的潜力价值依旧能打。
只听老秦又继续道：
“星海一中的校方也派人来接触了，经过更精密的测试，发现刘盈婉的异能潜力值为a级，你应该懂其中价值吧？”
王生点头。
a级潜力，意味着不出意外的话，异能的上限可达到六级能师，这是在全国范围内都是少有的存在。
而战力层面，六级能师对应的是六级武者，而武者五级即可成宗师，六级可称大宗师，七级可称武圣。
七级武圣，那是当世明面上的天花板，整个蓝星仅有一百余位，个个都是开宗立派级别的祖师级人物。
其之下的六级大宗师便不必多说，都是能镇守一方的存在，六级能师与其地位、实力完全对标，甚至还要高出一线。
那么刘盈婉的前途可想而知。
“我限制不了你的自由，但我叫你来也是想提点你，如果你真为刘盈婉考虑的话，就最好不要耽误她。”
老秦说着，居然破天荒地点起了一支烟。
王生记得自己从没见过他在学生面前抽烟。
content_en:
Just a chance?
Well, think about it. With the same grades, schools tend to prefer students with good talents and qualifications. This is a normal admissions strategy.
After all, energy, blood, and physical strength can all depend on food supplements, medicinal baths, and even acupuncture and medicine. As long as you have money, even a low-grade mortal can become a "genius" among his peers.
But the further you practice, the disadvantages of poor martial arts qualifications will become apparent. Unless your martial arts bones are awakened and your talents are improved, having money will not be of much use.
"But my qualifications will be retested during the high school entrance examination, so I don't have to worry about that."
When the time comes, he proves that he is not bad at martial arts, and it is not difficult to enter Qingjiang No. 1 Middle School.
In this regard, Wang Sheng was not in a hurry to explain to Lao Qin.
The course continues.
Lao Qin used Zhang Zhichao as an example to point out his lack of combat skills and decision-making experience, and even expanded and taught a variety of practical applications of supernatural powers.
As for Wang Sheng, Lao Qin didn't teach him.
It's not that he's partial or anything, but Lao Qin found that Wang Sheng hardly needed any guidance.
On the one hand, Wang Sheng's superpowers are very compatible with martial arts, so there is no need to change his combat ideas, and the knowledge he learned before is more useful.
On the other hand, judging from Wang Sheng's recent performance in actual combat exercises, his ability is indeed impeccable.
Such a person can cultivate himself to become a talent without too much refinement, but as to how far he can go depends on his own talent and opportunities.
With Lao Qin's in-depth explanation, the course progressed to the second half, and the actual combat training began.
The students each looked for opponents and tried their best to develop the practical effects of their abilities. Everyone made great progress.
Time soon came to the end of school at noon.
In the office, Wang Sheng stood beside Lao Qin's desk, waiting for his resignation.
"Wang Sheng, you are already impressive both in terms of health and combat ability. To be honest, I think you have a chance to get into Qingjiang No. 1 Middle School. I'm not lying, but I really think it's possible."
Lao Qin praised it while holding a thermos cup filled with wolfberry.
"If you had achieved such excellent results before, even if you wanted to fall in love, I would have turned a blind eye. I have come here at this age. Who doesn't know?"
Wang Sheng: "..."
Wang Sheng wanted to explain that he did not have puppy love, but he still stood aside silently and listened to the teachings.
"But it's different now. It has nothing to do with the high school entrance examination. It's about the target audience... Let me tell you straight. I talked with Liu Yingwan's father, and he finally decided to let Liu Yingwan go to Xinghai No. 1 Middle School."
Xinghai No. 1 Middle School?
Hearing this, Wang Sheng's expression changed slightly, but he was not surprised.
Judging from Liu Yingwan's supernatural potential, it is not difficult to enter Xinghai No. 1 Middle School.
Even in the top high school in the provincial capital city, Liu Yingwan's potential value is still high.
Just listen to Lao Qin continue:
"The school of Xinghai No. 1 Middle School has also sent people to get in touch. After more precise testing, it was found that Liu Yingwan's superpower potential is level A. You should understand the value of it, right?"
Wang Sheng nodded.
A-level potential means that if nothing unexpected happens, the upper limit of superpowers can reach level 6 masters, which is rare in the country.
In terms of combat power, level six masters correspond to level six warriors, and a warrior at level five can be called a grandmaster, level six can be called a grand master, and level seven can be called a martial saint.
Seventh-level Martial Saints were the upper limit of the world at that time. There were only a hundred or so in the entire Blue Star, and all of them were founder-level figures at the level of founders of sects.
Needless to say, the sixth-level grand masters below him are all beings who can guard one side. The sixth-level masters are completely on par with their status and strength, and are even a step above them.
Then Liu Yingwan's future can be imagined.
"I can't restrict your freedom, but I called you here to remind you. If you really think about Liu Yingwan, you'd better not delay her."
As Lao Qin spoke, he lit up a cigarette for the first time.
Wang Sheng remembered that he had never seen him inSmoking in front of students.
